title: unix_secs_to_rfc3339 accepts negative timestamps silently
description: kith-core/src/lib.rs unix_secs_to_rfc3339(secs: i64) is documented as correct from the Unix epoch (t=0) through 2299 but silently produces output for negative inputs (pre-1970 dates). The function is used by kith-store to format timestamps read from SQLite columns (message.rs lines 79-82, contact.rs lines 404-405). If a DB row somehow contains a negative timestamp (corruption, manual edit, or a test fixture), the function returns a plausible-looking but wrong date string that passes all downstream validation. An explicit panic or Err return for secs < 0 at the function boundary would catch this class of corruption earlier and more visibly.
